mssp.title: MSSP
mssp.subtitle: Managed Security Services Platform
mssp.summary: Managed security services with administrator, customer and SOC workspaces, security dashboards and REST API integration.

caseStudy.context: A managed security services platform with separate administrator, customer and SOC workspaces.
caseStudy.scope: Designed the UI/UX in Figma and developed core workspace interfaces and security dashboards. Integrated REST APIs with TanStack Query for caching, pagination and response normalization, and wrote unit and integration tests for API services and authentication flows using Vitest.

highlights: Designed UI/UX in Figma and developed administrator, customer and SOC workspaces with security dashboards.
Integrated API caching, pagination and response normalization; wrote Vitest tests for services and authentication.

payesh.title: Payesh
payesh.subtitle: Occupational Health Monitoring System
payesh.summary: An enterprise occupational health platform with role-based organization and clinic workflows, clinical examination forms and health contract management.

caseStudy.context: An occupational health monitoring platform with role-based interfaces for organizations and medical clinics.
caseStudy.scope: Developed clinical examination forms with shared Redux state, multi-step onboarding and SMS verification.

highlights: Developed clinical examination forms and multi-step onboarding with shared Redux state.
Integrated role-specific organization/clinic workflows and cached API data for occupational health records.

picopet.title: PicoPet
picopet.subtitle: Bilingual Veterinary Healthcare Platform
picopet.summary: A Persian/English veterinary care platform with appointment scheduling, pet medical records and role-based interfaces.

caseStudy.context: PicoPet is a comprehensive veterinary platform streamlining clinic discovery, specialist appointments, and pet medical history.
caseStudy.scope: Developed appointment scheduling and pet medical record management for pet owners, veterinarians and administrators. Implemented Persian/English localization with RTL/LTR support and API caching with TanStack Query.

highlights: Developed appointment scheduling and pet medical-record interfaces for owners, veterinarians and administrators.
Implemented Persian/English localization with RTL/LTR layouts and TanStack Query API caching.

salam-operator.title: Salam
salam-operator.subtitle: Ministry of Health National Healthcare Platform
salam-operator.summary: Iran’s Ministry of Health national platform for appointment booking, patient health records and remote consultations.

caseStudy.context: A national Ministry of Health platform for healthcare appointments, patient health records and telemedicine.
caseStudy.scope: Developed Jalali appointment booking, filterable specialist directories with infinite loading and map-based discovery, and patient health-record interfaces with themed medical charts. Implemented text consultations with file attachments, integrated APIs for video and voice meeting links and payment verification, and delivered real-time SSE notifications with browser alerts through Service Workers.

highlights: Developed Jalali booking and filterable specialist directories with infinite loading and map-based discovery.
Integrated text consultations, meeting/payment APIs and SSE browser alerts through Service Workers.

ganotic.title: Ganotic
ganotic.subtitle: Health & Wellness E-Commerce Platform
ganotic.summary: A health and wellness e-commerce platform with a Persian RTL Next.js PWA storefront, React admin panel and a reusable Figma design system.

caseStudy.context: A health and wellness e-commerce platform with a storefront and administration panel.
caseStudy.scope: Developed an installable Next.js PWA storefront with Persian RTL support and SEO-focused implementation. Built a React admin panel with order management, product catalog filtering and payment gateway integration, and designed the UI/UX and reusable design system in Figma.

highlights: Developed a Persian RTL Next.js PWA storefront and React admin panel for orders, catalog filtering and payments.
Designed the UI/UX and reusable design system in Figma.
